name: Tetronal
summary: Tetronal is a sedative-hypnotic and anesthetic drug with GABAergic actions. It is not as effective as trional.

pharmacology.text: Tetronal is a sedative-hypnotic and anesthetic drug with GABAergic actions.

uses.text: Tetronal is a sedative-hypnotic and anesthetic drug with GABAergic actions.

sideEffects.en: It is no longer used. Drugs of its type, the sulfonal hypnotics, built up in the body with repeated use and could cause confusion, unsteadiness and poisoning, including porphyria, a disorder that can turn urine dark red.
sideEffects.zh: 它已不再使用。這類sulfonal型安眠藥在反覆使用後會在體內累積，可能造成意識混亂、步態不穩與中毒，包括紫質症，這種疾病可能使尿液變成深紅色。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它已不再使用。这类sulfonal型安眠药在反复使用后会在体内累积，可能造成意识混乱、步态不稳与中毒，包括紫质症，这种疾病可能使尿液变成深红色。

fact.en: Tetronal is the last of a trio of early sleeping drugs: sulfonal, trional and tetronal. Its name reflects its four ethyl groups, one more than trional and two more than sulfonal.
fact.zh: Tetronal是早期三種安眠藥sulfonal、trional與tetronal中的最後一種。它的名稱反映出它帶有四個乙基，比trional多一個，比sulfonal多兩個。
fact.zhHans: Tetronal是早期三种安眠药sulfonal、trional与tetronal中的最后一种。它的名称反映出它带有四个乙基，比trional多一个，比sulfonal多两个。
